title: EAI: ADNI to FHIR via LLM-Powered ETL
description: An Extract, AI-Process, Integrate (EAI) pipeline that transforms the ADNI (Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative) dataset into HL7 FHIR R4 resources using a locally-deployed Llama 3.1 (8B) model via Ollama. Three-stage architecture: (1) terminology mapping to LOINC/SNOMED CT via OntoServer, (2) agentic JSONata generation via a ReAct loop, and (3) deterministic full-dataset transform. Designed for on-premises deployment to keep sensitive patient data behind the institutional firewall. Accompanies the manuscript submitted to The Journal of Precision Medicine: Health and Disease.
